message.content: I wake up around nine, usually after a few hours of sleep. My sister makes me breakfast—just porridge most days. I don’t eat much, to be honest. Then I get dressed and take the bus to the shop. It’s a short ride, maybe ten minutes. The shop is quiet in the mornings, so I just price the notebooks and organize the pens. I like the routine because it keeps me calm. Sometimes, though, I hear a voice when I’m alone. It doesn’t bother me too much, but it’s there. I just try not to think about it and keep working.
